_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: black and white comic strip panel, scratchy crow-quill pen and ballpoint ink on cardstock, harsh photocopy contrast, heavy black spotting, jagged uneven line weights, 1990s indie comix zine style, xerox grain, no color, no gray tones. a lineup model sheet of a 1990s small-town high school's people, front views, labeled: MR. HADLEY (man of fifty with a mustache and a sweater vest holding chalk), THE PRINCIPAL (bald man with a whistle on a lanyard, short-sleeved shirt and tie), THE YEARBOOK PHOTOGRAPHER (a patient bored girl in a hoodie with a big camera), THE BUS DRIVER (heavy woman with a permanent wave in a quilted vest, hands on a wheel, eyes ahead), THE CASHIER (teenage girl in a grocery apron chewing gum), THE GRUNION QUEEN (a girl in a sash and a paper crown over a raincoat waving with her whole arm), A STUDENT (a teenager with a backpack, passing, face turned away), A KID (a gap-toothed child of nine in a too-big raincoat with a pencil, and again in a bedsheet with a pillowcase). Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: color, gray gradients, photorealistic, 3D render, smooth digital line, watermark, extra fingers
